title: Moho style (named style and a shape's own inline style)
description: See docs/moho-project-file-format.md §8 for the full inheritance-resolution rule and the two-generation (version 1038 vs 1045) usage split. IMPORTANT: `line_width`, `line_caps`, and every `brush_*` field are PLAIN values, never channels - confirmed across every sampled style (Moho does not animate them).

Style.description: The exact same object shape is used both for doc.styles[] (a document-wide named style) and for shape.style (a shape's own, usually-partial style). A shape's own style additionally carries the inherited_style*_uuid/name fields shown on Shape (mesh.schema.json) - both locations (on the shape itself, or inside the shape's own style object) are observed in real files and both must be checked.

fill_style.description: A styled fill effect. Present BOTH on a named style AND inline on a shape's own style object; neither is rare (1160 named-style vs 652 inline across the 46-file sample set). Five variants observed as a fill: SS_Gradient2 (1401), SS_Halo (198), SS_Shaded (96), SS_Soft (91) and SS_Crayon (26). moho2svg.py only renders SS_Gradient2; every other variant emits a per-shape stderr warning and falls back to the shape's flat fill_color.
fill_style.x-moho-evidence: moho2svg.py:2632 in ResolvedStyle.resolve (trace: out/traced_keys.json, see tools/trace_fields.py)

fill_style_id.description: The effect KIND, as an integer parallel to the effect object's own `type` string: 0 = SS_Shaded, 2 = SS_Soft, 4 = SS_Halo, 9 = SS_Gradient2, 10 = SS_Texture2, 11 = SS_Shadow, 12 = SS_Crayon. Confirmed to agree with `type` in all 2003 effect instances across the sample set, with no exceptions - so it is redundant with `type` rather than an independent reference id (an earlier revision of this schema recorded it as "not decoded"). The enum lists every kind seen in ANY of the three slots, not just this one.

line_style.description: A styled STROKE effect rather than a fill. Four variants observed as a line: SS_Gradient2 (116 occurrences across 16 files), SS_Soft (40), SS_Shaded (18) and SS_Shadow (3). Unlike fill_style, every one of these sits on a NAMED style; none is inline on a shape. moho2svg.py reads this slot and renders SS_Gradient2 as a real paint server on the outline (`stroke` for a uniform-width outline, `fill` for a tapered one); the other three warn and draw a flat stroke. One caveat worth knowing: a gradient outline on a BRUSH stroke is also warned and drawn flat, because a brush tints image pixels rather than painting with a paint server - and all 6 drawn gradient outlines in the sample set are brush strokes.

fill_style2.description: A SECOND fill effect slot, layered on top of `fill_style`. Not rendered by moho2svg.py, which warns per shape and exports without the second effect.

Usable in all three slots, and most often a FILL - 91 fill_style vs 40 line_style vs 2 fill_style2 occurrences (an earlier revision of this schema described it as line-only, before the sample set grew). Not rendered by moho2svg.py, which warns per shape and draws the plain colour underneath.
